set -eu
if [ -f '/FIXTURE_HOME/.codex/model-bridge/service-config.json' ] && [ ! -L '/FIXTURE_HOME/.codex/model-bridge/service-config.json' ]; then
  PICKERMUX_CONFIG_PATH='/FIXTURE_HOME/.codex/model-bridge/service-config.json' exec node '/FIXTURE_HOME/Library/Application Support/PickerMux/current/bin/pickermux.mjs' "$@"
fi
PICKERMUX_CONFIG_PATH='/FIXTURE_HOME/Library/Application Support/PickerMux/current/lmstudio-picker.config.json' exec node '/FIXTURE_HOME/Library/Application Support/PickerMux/current/bin/pickermux.mjs' "$@"
